entry.title: Enable custom fields for Situation Handling (Service Contract Due to Expire Soon)
entry.content:
We are currently implementing the Service module in Public Cloud and are facing a requirement to add custom fields to the Situation Handling described in the Help documentation below:
Service Contract Due to Expire Soon | SAP Help Portal


I would like to share the approaches we have considered and the outcomes:

1. Extending the CDS view used by the standard Situation Handling
Our analysis showed that this Situation Handling is based on the CDS view C_SrvcContrItmExpryDetsSitn. However, since this CDS view is not released for extension, adding custom fields is not possible.

2. Implementing a custom Situation Handling based on CDS view I_ServiceContractCube_2
This CDS view is useful because it provides visibility into the remaining time until contract expiration (e.g., 3 weeks before, 2 weeks before).
We attempted to implement a similar custom Situation Handling based on this view; however, the challenge is that it does not expose the “Auto Renewal” indicator. As a result, there is a risk that notifications would be triggered even for contracts that are automatically renewed.

3. Implementing a custom Situation Handling based on CDS view I_SERVICECONTRACTENHCD
This CDS view provides the contract end date, but we encountered the same limitations as in #2.
Additionally, since the date is stored as a DEC type, it is not suitable for conditions such as “NEXT 90 DAYS.”

Based on the above, I would like to ask product development or experts who may have addressed similar requirements:

  • Is there any plan to release C_SrvcContrItmExpryDetsSitn or to enable field extensibility for this CDS view in alignment with custom field extensions?

  • If not, is there a plan to provide templates or sample implementations for custom Situation Handling, similar to those available in other modules?

  • If neither is planned, are there alternative CDS views better suited for this requirement beyond the ones in #2 and #3?
    If not, and a custom CDS view is necessary, which CDS views would you recommend combining to meet this requirement?

We appreciate your support and any guidance you can provide.

entry.title: Situation Handling for Maintenance Order – Trigger Notification at Post-Execution Phase in SAP Cloud
entry.content:
Dear experts,

I am working with Situation Handling in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud (Asset Management / EAM) and have a requirement to notify Production users when a maintenance order reaches the post-execution stage (i.e., maintenance work is completed and production can resume).

I explored the standard situation type
EAM_MAINT_ORDER_PHASE_CHANGED (Maintenance Order Phase Changed).

However, while configuring the conditions / anchor object filters, I noticed that:

  • Order Phase (Execution / Post-Execution) is not available as a condition

  • System Status (CNF / TECO) is also not available as a filter

  • Only header attributes such as Plant, Order Type, Equipment, Dates, etc. are exposed

In contrast, for Maintenance Notifications, phase and subphase are available as conditions, making it easier to trigger notifications.

My questions are:

  1. How can we trigger a situation notification specifically when a maintenance order enters the post-execution stage in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud?

  2. Is there any standard workaround or recommended approach to achieve this using Situation Handling?

  3. Is this a known limitation by design for maintenance orders in Public Cloud?

The goal is purely to inform Production users (via Fiori notification or email) that the maintenance activity is completed and they can resume operations — without using custom developments, as this is a Public Cloud system.

Any guidance, best practices, or confirmation from SAP experts would be greatly appreciated.


Regards,
Sriram R

entry.title: Situation Handling for Journal Entry Posting – Triggering Issue with CL_FINS_JOURNALENTRY_SOT_EVENT
entry.content:
SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Finance Situation Handling 

Dear experts,

I am working with Situation Handling in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and have a requirement to notify specific users via Fiori notification or email when a Journal Entry is posted, specifically based on criteria such as specific G/L accounts or Journal Entry Types.

I have completed the configuration for the following components:

  • Responsibility Management: Team and functions defined.

  • Situation Object / Scenario / Type: Configured and enabled the Situation Type.

However, despite these settings, the situation is not triggering as expected. When checking the Monitor Situations app and Application Logs, there is no evidence of any instance being created or any error logs being generated.

In my technical investigation, I am focusing on the anchor object class CL_FINS_JOURNALENTRY_SOT_EVENT. However, it is unclear exactly how or when this class is triggered within the Public Cloud environment.

My questions are:

  1. Triggering Mechanism: Does the ABAP event class CL_FINS_JOURNALENTRY_SOT_EVENT trigger the situation in real-time immediately upon Journal Entry posting (Save event)? Or does it require a background job scheduled via the "Schedule Situation Handling Jobs" app?

  2. Standard Workaround or Recommended Approach: Is there a specific standard Situation Scenario or Job Template recommended for triggering notifications based on Journal Entry attributes in Public Cloud?

  3. Known Limitation by Design: Is the direct triggering of situations from the Journal Entry posting event a known limitation in the current version of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud?

The goal is to inform relevant stakeholders immediately when a specific posting occurs using the standard Situation Handling framework, avoiding custom BAdI developments where possible.

Any guidance, best practices, or confirmation regarding the behavior of this specific class and situation object would be greatly appreciated.

Regards,
M. Kitakatsu
